Package dev.turboism.sdk.ui.table

Interface SceneTableService

All Known Implementing Classes:
SceneTableService.Unavailable
public interface SceneTableService
Preview service for the native Scene palette table.

The table identifier is currently fixed to SCENE_TABLE_ID. The runtime owns the native table, dispatch thread, snapshot generation, and host ordering semantics. Registrations subscribe only to semantic immutable values and should be closed on plugin shutdown. A fake or unavailable service must not be treated as evidence of a real-host table provider.

      Registration onSnapshot(String tableId, Consumer<SceneTableService.TableSnapshot> listener)

    • setItemOrder

      default void setItemOrder(String tableId, List<String> itemIds)
      Sets the complete table order using zero-based positions.

      The default implementation delegates once per item. Available implementations may override it with one native operation.

      Parameters:
      tableId - SCENE_TABLE_ID
      itemIds - item identities in target order

    • setManualReordering

      default void setManualReordering(String tableId, boolean enabled)
      Enables or disables native manual row dragging for plugin-managed ordering.

      The default is a no-op for compatibility. It does not simulate native dragging when the provider is absent.

      Parameters:
      tableId - SCENE_TABLE_ID
      enabled - whether manual reordering should be enabled

    • unavailable

      static SceneTableService unavailable()
      Returns the no-op unavailable service.

      It registers no-op handles and ignores mutations. It is an availability fallback, not a host-readiness signal.

      Returns:
      singleton unavailable service
